summary: A Depth subscription to an index: the index feed's tick comes out as a full frame with the price and the day's range.

deviations.reason: An SFeed index packet carries no volume; the web's index normaliser writes volume 0 (sfeed_websocket.py::_to_index) and publishes it, a zero the exchange never sent. The desktop leaves it out (web openalgo#2376).

The web's Kotak adapter publishes the change as percent_change only (the packet's nc); the desktop also sends the canonical price_change and price_change_percent. Kotak's entry turns them off once lane wire's per-broker key rule (decisions 9 Nov) is on the base.

The web's Kotak adapter answers a Depth subscription to an index with its price over an empty book (depth: {buy: [], sell: []}); the desktop renders no depth key for an index until lane wire's per-broker index book rule (Absent / EmptyBook) is on the base (lead ruling R1).
deviations.ref: kotak_adapter.py:617-640; feed::protocol::market (no book for an index)

deviations.reason: An index has no book; the web sends its book totals as 0 under the Kotak name (extras.get(..., 0)), numbers the exchange never sent. The desktop leaves them out.
